description: This Java class implements a Spring Batch Tasklet responsible for processing and sending external events asynchronously within the Fineract platform. It retrieves queued events, partitions them, serializes messages, and marks events as sent, utilizing thread pools and transaction management.

classes.name: SendAsynchronousEventsTasklet
classes.description: A Spring Batch Tasklet that handles asynchronous sending of external events, including fetching, partitioning, serializing, and marking events as sent.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method invoked by Spring Batch to process events; checks if downstream channels are enabled, retrieves queued events, and initiates sending.

methods.name: isDownstreamChannelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if either JMS or Kafka external event producers are enabled in configuration.

methods.name: getQueuedEventsBatch
methods.description: Retrieves a batch of queued external events to be sent, based on configured batch size.

methods.name: sendEvents
methods.description: Coordinates the process of partitioning, sending, and marking events as sent.

methods.name: sendEventsToProducer
methods.description: Sends serialized event messages to the external event producer.

methods.name: markEventsAsSent
methods.description: Marks a list of event IDs as sent in the repository, using parallel execution and transaction management.

methods.name: generatePartitions
methods.description: Groups events by aggregate root ID and creates message byte arrays for each group.

methods.name: createMessages
methods.description: Serializes individual events into byte array messages using a message factory and byte buffer converter.

methods.name: getBatchSize
methods.description: Retrieves the external event batch size from configuration.
